playThroughs: the game loads to the title screen with no errors
clearing 1-1 shows a centered LEVEL CLEAR box that waits for the player
a normal jump lands on the sky blocks and the boss arena's platforms
standing still on a moving platform carries the player along with it
R restarts the level once, for free, and the controls hint says so
a missed boss question warns it comes back, then returns tagged
touching the boss shows the don't-touch tip once per fight
the boss's win and game-over boxes sit centered in the sky
beating a boss offers SEND FEEDBACK until this device has sent some
the credits screen shows the copyright, with every line inside the frame and none overlapping
double-clicking BACK on the credits screen stays on the title screen
a click right after the title screen opens doesn't pick an option
REVIEW goes straight to the boss fights, then scores each section
REVIEW can test one section: one boss fight, then its results
MISSED QUESTIONS retests only what you got wrong, and right answers drop off
the Notebook reaches a world in two clicks and only pages through what's unlocked
every practice and boss question in every built-in paper fits its box
on a phone, every option on the menus and new screens is big enough to tap
on a phone, the professor's tour says how to tap, and its X is easy to hit
a new player's first NEW GAME starts the professor's tour, every step neat on its own screen
the X ends the tour from any step, and ABOUT can replay it
